summary.goal: Enable step-level commenting during plan review (like code review)
summary.context: Reviewers need to give feedback on specific steps. Comments are persistent, threaded, and can be resolved. This creates a review dialogue before approval.

acceptance_criteria.description: Comment icon visible on each step
Click opens comment thread for that step
Comments show author, timestamp, content
Comments can be replied to (threaded)
Comments can be marked resolved
Unresolved comment count shown on step and plan
Comments persist across sessions

cases.description: CommentThread renders when comment icon clicked on step
Comments fetched from API and displayed in thread
New comment POSTs to API and appears in list
Panel closes on overlay click and close button
Reply creates threaded comment with parent_id
Resolve button marks comment as resolved via API
Empty comment input disables submit button
No comments shows empty state message
API error on fetch shows error state
API error on post shows error feedback

data_requirements: Comments: mix of resolved and unresolved
Mock API responses for success and error cases
plan_tests.notes: Focus on integration between CommentThread and PlanEditorPage. Backend API already tested separately.

design_spec.notes: Follows existing ChatPanel pattern - right-edge slide-in with overlay

views.name: CommentThread Panel
views.layout: fixed right-edge, 400px width, full height, z-index 1000
views.trigger: Click comment icon on step header

elements.use: inline textarea under parent when replying

states.loading: Show loading spinner in comment-list area
states.empty: Centered message: No comments yet. Start the conversation!

views.name: Step Comment Icon
views.layout: inline in step-editor-header, after scope badge, before actions

elements.states: muted gray (no comments), primary blue (has unresolved)

elements.props: absolute positioned, top-right, primary bg, white text, min-width 16px

views.name: Plan Header Comments Badge
views.layout: in plan-meta div, after version badge
views.interaction: Informational only for MVP (no click action)

panel_coexistence.behavior: Opening CommentThread closes ChatPanel and vice versa

page_state: commentStepId: string | null - which step's comments are showing
comments: Comment[] - all comments for the plan
data_flow: 1. On page load: GET /plans/:id/comments -> comments state
2. On icon click: set commentStepId, filter comments for that step
3. On add comment: POST to API, optimistic add to comments array
4. On resolve: PATCH to API, update comment in array

steps.title: Add comment storage to backend
steps.description: Create comments table and API endpoints for CRUD operations on comments.

acceptance_criteria.description: comments table: id, plan_id, step_id, author, content, created_at, resolved
parent_id for threading
GET /plans/:id/comments returns [{ id, plan_id, step_id, author, content, created_at, resolved, parent_id }]
POST /plans/:id/comments accepts { step_id, author, content, parent_id? }
PATCH /plans/:id/comments/:comment_id accepts { resolved: boolean }

steps.title: Add comment icon to step cards
steps.description: Comment bubble icon in step-editor-header (per design_spec v002). Icon state varies: muted gray when no comments, primary blue with badge when has unresolved.

acceptance_criteria.description: Comment icon in step header, after scope badge, before actions
Icon muted gray when no comments, primary blue when has unresolved
Badge (absolute positioned, top-right, primary bg, white text, min-width 16px) shows unresolved count if > 0
Click calls onCommentClick(stepId) prop
Highlighted/active background when panel is open for this step

steps.title: Create CommentThread component
steps.description: Standalone slide-in panel component (per design_spec v001). Fixed right-edge, 400px width, full height, z-index 1000. Semi-transparent overlay with click-to-close. Contains header, stats bar, scrollable comment list, and input footer.

acceptance_criteria.description: Panel: fixed right 0, width 400px, height 100vh, z-index 1000, white background, box-shadow left
Overlay: fixed fullscreen, rgba(0,0,0,0.3), click triggers onClose
Header: title (Comments), step name, close button (X)
Stats bar: unresolved count, toggle for showing resolved
Comment list: scrollable area, renders comment-item for each
Comment item: author, timestamp, content, reply button, resolve button
Input footer: textarea + submit button
States: loading (spinner), empty (No comments yet message), error (retry option), submitting (disabled)
Close triggers: overlay click, close button, Escape key
Props: { stepId, stepTitle, comments, onClose, onAddComment, onResolve }

steps.title: Integrate CommentThread into PlanEditorPage
steps.description: Wire CommentThread into PlanEditorPage with panel coexistence rule (design_spec.panel_coexistence). Implement state management per design_spec.state_management: activePanel tracks which panel is open, commentStepId tracks which step's comments to show. Opening CommentThread must close ChatPanel and vice versa.

acceptance_criteria.description: State: activePanel: 'chat' | 'comments' | null (replaces separate isChatOpen)
State: commentStepId: string | null - which step's comments panel is open
State: comments: Comment[] - all comments for the plan
State: loadingComments: boolean
On page load: GET /plans/:id/comments -> comments state
Opening CommentThread sets activePanel='comments', closes ChatPanel
Opening ChatPanel sets activePanel='chat', closes CommentThread
CommentThread rendered when activePanel='comments' and commentStepId set
Comments filtered by commentStepId before passing to CommentThread
New comments POST to API, optimistic add to comments array
onClose sets activePanel=null, commentStepId=null
StepEditor receives onCommentClick prop, commentCount (filtered by step_id), isCommentPanelOpen (for highlight)

steps.title: Implement reply threading
steps.description: Reply button on comments shows inline reply-form (per design_spec v001 reply-form element). Replies created with parent_id, indented in display.

acceptance_criteria.description: Reply button on each root comment
Click shows inline textarea under the parent comment
Submit POSTs with parent_id set to parent comment id
Replies rendered indented (margin-left) under parent
Cancel button hides reply form

steps.title: Implement comment resolution
steps.description: Resolve button on root comments marks thread as resolved. Stats bar shows unresolved count and toggle to show/hide resolved threads.

acceptance_criteria.description: Resolve button on root comments (not replies)
PATCH /plans/:id/comments/:comment_id with { resolved: true }
Resolved threads hidden by default (showResolved: false state)
Toggle link in stats bar: Show resolved (N) / Hide resolved
Resolved comments styled with muted opacity or strikethrough
Can unresolve by clicking resolve button again

steps.title: Show unresolved count on plan header
steps.description: Badge in PlanHeader showing total unresolved comments (per design_spec v003). Amber background (#fef3c7), amber text (#92400e). Hidden when count is 0. Informational only for MVP (no click action).

acceptance_criteria.description: Badge in plan-meta div, after version badge
Text: N unresolved comments
Style: amber bg (#fef3c7), amber text (#92400e), badge class
Hidden when unresolved count is 0
Count derived from comments.filter(c => !c.resolved && !c.parent_id).length
